description: This file defines a PHP trait named SocialCommitmentRelationsTrait that provides methods to manage social commitment relations within a model class, including adding, replacing, retrieving, and removing social commitments, as well as retrieving relational table names.

methods.name: getSocialCommitmentRelationalTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the relational table used to store social commitment relationships based on the current model's table name.

methods.name: addSocialCommitments
methods.description: Adds one or multiple social commitments to the model, optionally removing others not included.

methods.name: replaceSocialCommitments
methods.description: Replaces all existing social commitments with new ones.

methods.name: getSocialCommitments
methods.description: Retrieves all social commitments associated with the current model instance.

methods.name: removeSocialCommitments
methods.description: Removes specified social commitments from the model.

methods.name: getMainSocialCommitment
methods.description: Returns the first social commitment associated with the model, or null if none.
